preconditions.name: R1_realised_first_action_entropy_varies_across_arms
preconditions.description: Measured committed first-action entropy RANGE across the 4 noise-floor arms exceeds the floor -- the sweep actually moved realised entropy (else the floor sweep is vacuous). SAME statistic (first_action_entropy) the floor verdict locates.

preconditions.name: R2_topk_shortlist_conversion_nonvacuous
preconditions.description: 569i top-k shortlist engaged: shortlist active, mode==top_k, mean shortlist size ~= k on a majority of arms. Without the conversion engaged, realised entropy cannot reach committed behaviour and discriminator accuracy cannot be read as a function of entropy.

preconditions.name: R3_discriminator_nondegenerate
preconditions.description: ARC-062 gating_weight carries cross-tick RANGE (not pinned) AND both reef-half and forage-half contexts were sampled, on a majority of arms. A pinned discriminator gives a degenerate accuracy readout. RANGE statistic.
preconditions.control: gated_policy gating_weight cross-tick range + context tick counts
